items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Gus Cannon, Will Shea, Ben Ramey? [INTERVIEWEE] I know Bill Ramey. Yeah.

ctx.x: a rather a six string I mean a 12 string sounds good but I just have my practice on it yeah it's a nice box there yeah it is

you just use your thumb and forefinger of your right hand huh? yeah so I get it when I get the playing trade I catch them all of it you catch them all? yes use all five fingers yeah I use all five fingers so you don't have to have a nickname huh? what do they call you? Pete? yes they call me Pete for a nickname and what other nicknames? well that's all it's Robert yes Robert Pete huh? yes well we ought to make up a good one for doing the album yeah that's what you're doing well you would set this up the way you…
Well, you see, it used to be a regular player all the time, and I'd shake them all down. Everybody started calling them Shakey.

items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Made by the guitar can of the blues.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. The bottles are substituted. Yeah, yeah. What kind of steel do they use? What is it? Is it wrap around your finger like that? No, sir, it's just a kind of... A flat piece like this. And they set the guitar flat on their lap? Yes, sir. But I can't play it flat on my hand. Okay, we'll do that again a little bit in time. That won't let you have a knife here. A knife? Do you want a knife? Always. Well, I mean, you know, some people use a knife on the blade. Oh, I don't know what. But he doesn't. No, I was…

Jazz... Jazz Bo Blues. Jazz Bo... Jazz Bo... Yeah. What is your name? Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Jazz Bo Boogie. Made by the guitar can of the blues. Hey! Made by the what? Guitar can of the blues. Oh, yes, that's how it got my way.

Oh, yeah. Get a little bit of your life story and all that, you know. Uh, what's your full name? Robert Wells. Robert Wells. And your number? 39811. 39811. Yes, sir. And where were you born? Memphis, Tennessee. Memphis, Tennessee. You know Gus Cannon, Will Shea, Ben Ramey?
